intro.text: Stone Oak is a master-planned community in north San Antonio along US-281 and Loop 1604 with a median sale price near $450,000 and roughly 55 days on market. The area draws families and professionals with top-rated NEISD schools, a mature retail and medical corridor, and established neighborhoods ranging from the $300s to over $1M.

good.title: Top-rated NEISD schools
good.description: Reagan High School, Bush Middle, and multiple elementary campuses consistently rank among the best in San Antonio.

good.title: Mature retail and medical corridor
good.description: Stone Oak Parkway and US-281 offer groceries, dining, urgent care, and specialty medical within minutes.

good.title: Established neighborhoods
good.description: Homes from the 1990s through new construction. Mature trees, community pools, and walkable streets.

good.title: Strong resale market
good.description: NEISD schools and north-side location drive consistent demand from relocating families and Military buyers.

warn.title: US-281 congestion
warn.description: 281 between Loop 1604 and Bitters backs up daily during rush hour. Evenings northbound are worst.

warn.title: Bexar County taxes
warn.description: Effective rate approximately 2.10%. Higher than Comal or Kendall County alternatives north of 1604.

warn.title: HOA variation
warn.description: HOA dues range from $50 to $200+ monthly depending on the subdivision. Gated communities run higher.

warn.title: Price floor rising
warn.description: Entry-level homes in the $300s are increasingly rare. Most resale starts above $400K.

items.title: Property taxes
items.description: Stone Oak falls within Bexar County with an effective property tax rate of approximately 2.10%. On a $450,000 home that is roughly $9,450/year before the homestead exemption. For current rates and exemption forms, visit the Bexar Appraisal District.

items.title: Closing timeline
items.description: Cash transactions close in 14 to 21 days. Financed purchases run 30 to 45 days depending on lender and appraisal turnaround.

items.title: HOA presence
items.description: Most Stone Oak subdivisions have an HOA. Dues range from $50 to $200/month. Gated communities like Sonterra and The Heights at Stone Oak run higher.

faq.question: What is the median home price in Stone Oak?
faq.answer: Approximately $450,000, averaging $195/sqft. Prices range from the $300s in older sections to over $1M in gated communities like Sonterra and The Heights.

faq.question: What school district serves Stone Oak?
faq.answer: North East ISD (NEISD). Reagan High School and Johnson High School are the primary high school campuses. Verify attendance zones by address with the district.

faq.question: How far is Stone Oak from downtown San Antonio?
faq.answer: About 18 miles south via US-281. Off-peak drive time is 20 to 25 minutes. Rush hour can stretch to 35 to 50 minutes.

faq.question: What are the best neighborhoods in Stone Oak?
faq.answer: Sonterra (golf course, country club), Heights at Stone Oak (gated, newer), Stone Oak Park (original sections, mature trees), and Rogers Ranch (master-planned, family-oriented).

faq.question: Is Stone Oak good for families?
faq.answer: Yes. Top-rated NEISD schools, community pools, parks, and family-oriented retail along Stone Oak Parkway. US-281 congestion during rush hour is the main tradeoff.

faq.question: What are property taxes in Stone Oak?
faq.answer: Bexar County effective rate is approximately 2.10%. On a $450,000 home that is roughly $9,450/year before homestead exemption.

faq.question: Is there new construction in Stone Oak?
faq.answer: Limited. Most new construction is in The Heights at Stone Oak and adjacent communities. Resale dominates the core Stone Oak area.

faq.question: What is the commute from Stone Oak to USAA?
faq.answer: About 8 miles via Loop 1604, 10 to 15 minutes off-peak. USAA is one of the closest major employers.
